author: Pallas, 1776
status: 나그네새 수만 마리 · 겨울철새 수백 마리
habitat: 습지의 버드나무 숲, 숲 사이 공터, 버드나무 관목이 흩어진 툰드라 초원(번식지)
summary: 봄과 가을에 작은 무리를 지어 한반도를 지나가는 나그네새로, 일부는 남부 지방에 머물며 겨울을 나는 비교적 드문 겨울새이기도 하다. 여름에는 암수가 함께 지내고 겨울에는 크고 작은 무리를 이룬다. 딱정벌레류 곤충과 잡초 씨를 먹으며, 습지의 버드나무 숲이나 숲 사이 공터, 버드나무 관목이 흩어진 툰드라 초원에 둥지를 틀고 한배에 알 4~5개, 드물게 6개를 낳는다. 구북구 동부, 러시아 북부, 바이칼호, 야쿠츠크 남부 등지에 분포하고 한국 남부, 중국 동부 윈난성, 인도차이나, 히말라야 동부, 네팔 등지에서 겨울을 난다.

points.en: black crown with a broad chestnut median stripe
black spots below and behind the ear-coverts
buff breast and flanks with many short black streaks

art.subject: Little Bunting (Emberiza pusilla), adult in non-breeding plumage (sexes nearly alike), as seen in Korea from October to April: black lateral crown stripes bordering a broad chestnut median crown stripe; lores, supercilium and ear-coverts rufous-chestnut, the ear-coverts framed behind and below by a thin black border with black spots; a narrow pale eye-ring; buffy-white throat with a thin black lateral throat stripe that does not reach the bill; mantle grey-brown streaked dark; two pale wing-bars; breast and flanks buff with many short, fine black streaks; belly and undertail coverts white; tail dark with white outer feathers. Small conical bill with a straight culmen, grey with a darker tip; dark brown eye; pinkish-brown legs.
art.pose: feeding on the ground among weeds, picking up seeds
art.scene: Korean autumn: weedy open ground beside willow scrub at the edge of a wetland; no people, buildings or text
views: adult non-breeding, side view perched on a weed stem: chestnut median crown stripe between black lateral stripes, rufous-chestnut face with black rear border, thin pale eye-ring, incomplete black throat stripe, buff breast and flanks with short black streaks, white belly

adult, head detail in side view: broad chestnut median crown stripe, rufous-chestnut lores, supercilium and ear-coverts, black spots below and behind the ear-coverts, pale eye-ring, small straight-edged grey bill
art.build: Very small bunting, smaller than a sparrow, compact, with a rather short tail for a bunting; neat rounded head with no crest, sometimes slightly peaked when alert. Bill small, conical and sharply pointed with a straight culmen, shorter than the head. Legs short, pinkish-brown. Tail medium length and notched, dark with white outer feathers. Feeds quietly on the ground among weeds and flies up into low bushes.
avoid: Do not paint a crest, rufous-streaked flanks or a rufous nape; that is Rustic Bunting (Emberiza rustica).
Do not paint dark ear-coverts or a dark eye-stripe across the face; the whole face is rufous-chestnut with only a black rear border.
Do not paint a large or swollen bill; it is small with a straight culmen.
Do not streak the breast in brown or rufous; the streaks are fine and black.
